name: Liam O'Connell
bio:
Liam's fascination with motorsport began as a child, tinkering with go-karts in his family's Dublin garage. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at Trinity College before landing a junior engineering role with a Formula Ford team. His sharp analytical skills and knack for problem-solving quickly propelled him through the ranks. He spent several years in European GT racing before accepting a position with VW Racing Brasil, drawn by their commitment to innovation and pushing the boundaries of motorsport technology.

As Chief Engineer, Liam is known for his meticulous approach and ability to maintain a cool head under pressure. He believes in empowering his team and fostering a collaborative environment where every idea is valued. Liam's strategic thinking and focus on long-term performance make him a valuable asset to the team, constantly seeking marginal gains and exploring new technologies to improve the car's overall performance. He is constantly studying data and race footage to find areas for improvement.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Liam is of average height with a lean build and intense, focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a specific type of Irish breakfast tea every morning before starting work.
